## Usage

**Grade for this unit:** `86.7%` Epitech's tests passed.

Close the repo

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Leorevoir/strace.git
```

Install dependencies packages with Nix

```nix
nix develop
```

Or manually install `libelf`.

Build the project

```bash
make
```

Execute the binary !

```bash
./strace --help
```
